from shop.legacy_money import legacy_round
from shop.money import round_half
from shop.report_money import report_round


def test_round_half_up():
    assert round_half(25) == 3 and round_half(24) == 2


def test_round_negative_half_away_from_zero():
    assert round_half(-25) == -3


def test_copies_round_the_same():
    assert [legacy_round(value) for value in (-35, -4, 0, 15, 44)] == [report_round(value) for value in (-35, -4, 0, 15, 44)]
